New York: WatchTime New York opens at Gotham Hall on 16 October with a record 48 exhibiting brands, the most in its 11-year history.

Waitlisted independents like Kudoke and Ferdinand Berthoud are exhibiting alongside majors like Blancpain. The Windup Watch Fair and brand showings around Manhattan make it New York's unofficial Watch Week.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
